_comment: Plugin configuration for the Credit 360 cockpit. ONE COCKPIT PER ORGANIZATION, RESOLVED PER VIEWER: this page declares runtime capabilities (connectors and a store), and a capability-declaring artifact can be shared inside its own claude.ai organization and never by public link, so `canonicalArtifactUrl` opens only for seats in the organization it was published from and answers 'artifact not found' everywhere else. It is therefore a FALLBACK, not a promise. The skill's open resolves in order: (1) the URL this session's own Artifact publish returned; (2) the most recently updated artifact titled 'Credit 360 · Relationship Cockpit' (or the older 'Customer 360 · Relationship Cockpit') that the viewer owns or is shared, found with Artifact action:'list' scope:'all' and verified with action:'read'; (3) this canonicalArtifactUrl, and only if action:'read' succeeds for it; (4) otherwise publish the bundled template as a new artifact and tell the viewer they can share it to their organization from the page's Share control. Steps 1 to 3 are one listing call and one read: no fetch, no assembler, no publish. Change this value only when the canonical cockpit is republished to a new URL. Never put a passcode, token or secret in this file. FIXED PUBLISH VALUES, for step (4) and for every republish: favicon 🏦 on the FIRST publish of a cockpit and never changed afterwards (a redeploy passes no favicon at all and keeps the icon the artifact has, because bankers find the tab by its icon and a changed one reads as a different page); title exactly 'Credit 360 · Relationship Cockpit', which is the string step (2) matches on, so a renamed cockpit is unresolvable for its own viewer; and the data a first open bakes is the bundled snapshot assets/live-data.json, the baked FIRST PAINT the page then refreshes lane by lane through the viewer's own connectors. assets/sample-data.json is for the repo's tests and render probes only and is never published to a banker.
